incident: A browser-mode proof printed the dev server’s transformed src/lib/appMode.ts, which Vite had inlined the whole import.meta.env object into. That output carried the Anthropic API key and was pasted into a chat transcript.
disclosedBy: this assistant, during the Stage B acceptance pass
ownerAction: revoke the disclosed key and issue a replacement, outside any assistant session
noSecretValuePrinted: this audit reports variable names, match counts and salted fingerprints only; no key, no .env contents and no import.meta.env dump appear in any output or artifact

rootCause.what: the variable carried the VITE_ prefix
rootCause.why: Vite does not substitute a single property of import.meta.env — in dev it inlines the ENTIRE env object into every module that references it, so the key was served inside modules with no Anthropic involvement at all
rootCause.proof: src/lib/appMode.ts, which only reports whether this is the public build, served 1 sk-ant- match before the fix and 0 after

liveSite.note: the full import graph was followed from index.html, not just the entry chunks

gitHistory.conclusion: the key was never committed, so no history rewrite is required

whyShippedBuildsWereAlreadyClean: .env.production and .env.public blank the key, and the desktop build takes it from the Rust backend at runtime. The exposure was confined to the dev server — which is where it happened.

fix.devPath: vite.config.ts reads it with loadEnv(mode, cwd, "") in Node and attaches it to /anthropic-proxy requests in a proxyReq hook; the browser holds only the placeholder "proxied-by-the-dev-server"
fix.desktopPath: unchanged — the Rust backend still supplies the key via invoke("get_anthropic_key")
fix.publishedSite: unchanged — no key, no proxy, AI unavailable, exactly as before

remainingVitePrefixedValues.VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY: public by design — a Firebase web config identifies the project; Firestore rules are the enforcement
remainingVitePrefixedValues.VITE_CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN: public by design — a Cloudflare Web Analytics beacon token
remainingVitePrefixedValues.verdict: no secret carries the VITE_ prefix any more

residualStringInBundles: the literal name ANTHROPIC_API_KEY survives once, inside the vendored SDK constructor default that reads process.env — absent in a browser, and a name rather than a value
